interest with a low 15% A.P.R.* And has a credit
limit of $5,000 if you qualify.
For an application, write to: America West
FlightFUND™ VISA, 51 W. Third Street, Tempe,
AZ 85281.

billing cycles with no beginning balance and with no cash advance
transactions. Annual membership fee $35.
